replaces.idea: A chrome pop-up toaster with a half-ejected slice of toast representing transient toast notifications.
A mechanical four-drum odometer counter on rubber feet representing determinate progress tracking.
A retro desk intercom with a speaker grille and push-to-talk key representing real-time messaging.
A weighted brass receipt spindle with stacked paper slips representing an undo/redo history stack.
A wooden clipboard with a brass spring clip holding a pinned note representing the clipboard pasteboard buffer.
A desktop battery-pack unit with a glowing charge bar and power cord representing device power and connectivity state.
A brass-ringed magnifying loupe on a hinged desk stand over a slip representing client-side search and indexing.
An oval wooden painter's palette with four bright paint dabs on a low stand representing color-space and theme palettes.
A wall-mounted corkboard with a red-headed pushpin and a pinned map card representing geolocation and pinning.

new.name: Pasteboard
new.depicts: A wooden clipboard leaning on a small easel stand, topped by a wide brass spring clip holding a cream paper slip.
new.focal: The wide brass spring clip clamping the top of the paper slip.

new.name: Undo Spike
new.depicts: A weighted round brass desk spindle with a vertical needle skewering three stacked cream paper slips.
new.focal: The vertical brass needle piercing the stack of paper slips.

new.name: Toast Pop
new.depicts: A rounded chrome-and-enamel two-slot toaster sitting on four dark rubber feet with a golden slice of toast half-ejected from the top.
new.focal: The golden slice of toast popping out of the top slot.

new.name: Query Loupe
new.depicts: A brass-rimmed magnifying lens mounted on a short hinged desk arm poised over a small white index slip.
new.focal: The bright glass lens framed in brass above the slip.

new.name: Ping Box
new.depicts: A boxy retro desk intercom on rubber feet with a slotted front speaker grille and a red push-to-talk key.
new.focal: The red push-to-talk key beside the slotted speaker grille.

new.name: Theme Palette
new.depicts: An oval wooden painter's palette resting on a low peg stand, dotted with four bright paint dabs in red, yellow, green, and blue.
new.focal: The four bright paint dabs arranged along the palette rim.

new.name: Progress Drum
new.depicts: A compact dark-cased mechanical counter on rubber feet with four side-by-side white number drums behind a narrow window.
new.focal: The row of four white mechanical counter drums.

new.name: Pinboard
new.depicts: A wooden-framed corkboard mounted on the wall holding a cream map card anchored by a single red-headed pushpin.
new.focal: The red-headed pushpin pinning the map card to the cork.

new.name: Power Brick
new.depicts: A heavy desktop battery-backup unit with a dark vented casing, a glowing green charge-level bar, and a coiled power cord.
new.focal: The glowing green charge-level bar on the front bezel.
